title: Jucy Mediterranean Prawns Paella
description: A rich and flavorful paella dish featuring tender prawns and a dairy-free friendly mother sauce base. Perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Heat the saffron infused olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for another 5 minutes, until tender.
Add the chopped tomato, garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the tomato starts to break down.
Add the uncooked Spanish rice and stir to coat the rice in the oil and mix with the tomato mixture. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Add the raw tiger prawns to the pan and cook, uncovered, for 2-3 minutes, until they are pink and cooked through.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes, covered, before serving.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
